name: io.github.henny-bee/sensekit-mcp
description: MCP server for Qlik Sense Enterprise on Windows: inspect, troubleshoot, govern and build apps.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the Qlik Sense node, no scheme (e.g. sense.example.com).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: 'certificate' (service identity via QMC-exported certs), 'jwt' (per-user, through a JWT virtual proxy) or 'windows' (a Windows account through the proxy's login form, no certificates). Defaults to certificate.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the QMC-exported client certificate (PEM). Required in certificate mode; also enables the Proxy-API session tools in jwt mode.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_CERT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the client certificate private key (PEM).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_ROOT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Qlik root CA (PEM). Supply it to keep TLS verification on.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_CERT_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the client certificate key, if it has one.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_CERT_USER_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: User directory asserted on QRS and engine calls in certificate mode.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_CERT_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id asserted in certificate mode. Prefer a dedicated least-privilege account.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_JWT
environmentVariables.description: Signed JWT for the virtual proxy (jwt mode only).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_JWT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the JWT (jwt mode; used when QSEOW_JWT is empty).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_VP_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Virtual proxy prefix. Empty means 'jwt' in jwt mode and the unprefixed default proxy in windows mode.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Windows account as DOMAIN\user (windows mode only).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the Windows account (windows mode only).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_PASSWORD_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the password (windows mode; used when QSEOW_PASSWORD is empty).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to register write tools. Default false: mutating tools are never registered, so the tool list is genuinely read-only.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_TOOL_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated personas to expose: analyst, developer, admin.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set false only for self-signed lab certificates. Leave on in production.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser that render_sheet starts headless: a channel (msedge, chrome) or a path to the browser. Defaults to msedge on Windows, chrome elsewhere.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_QRS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Repository Service (QRS) port, certificate mode.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_ENGINE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Engine (QIX) WebSocket port, certificate mode.

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_PROXY_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Proxy port (jwt and windows mode).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_QPS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Proxy Service REST API port (session tools; certificate auth only).

environmentVariables.name: QSEOW_ENV_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a .env file to read. Variables already set in the environment win.
